changes.name: UpgradeStationLayout
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")
local stations=world:WaitForChild("UpgradeStations")

-- Put all three stations in one evenly-spaced row on the LEFT side of the map.
local positions={
 MiningPowerStation=Vector3.new(-55,4,-14),
 MiningSpeedStation=Vector3.new(-55,4,0),
 MiningLuckStation=Vector3.new(-55,4,14)
}

for name,pos in pairs(positions) do
 local station=stations:WaitForChild(name)
 station.Position=pos
 station.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,90,0)
end

print("Upgrade stations aligned evenly on the left")
